name: Astral Battler Crux: Gilded Lily
source:
"It makes your fights easier, doesn’t it, magical girl? Another monster of the week like your favorite PR***Y C**E."

Astral Battler Crux: Gilded Lily is an 18+ kinetic visual novel about magical girls. Contains sexual content and dark themes.

"Astral Battlers are heroes of justice, beautiful maidens who save ordinary folks from the wicked Crepin. I see something in you, that spark of true heroism, that spark of HER. Won't you be my Crux?" - Herald Yue

"It's time to break out of this mundanity! After all, don't you want to rampage too?" - Icon Crepin Jailbreak

"They said a magical girl was spotted attacking people, how is that possible? Are we in danger too?" - Bystander

[From [url=https://team-astral-battler-crux.itch.io/astral-battler-crux-gilded-lily]itch.io[/url]]
